claims.value: 5.5 kg
3D-printed PETG; steel shafts and bearings
NEMA 17 stepper motors, one per joint
Planetary gearboxes on joints 2, 3 and 6; HTD3 belts on joints 1, 3, 4 and 5
Limit switches on joints 2, 3 and 5; inductive sensors on joints 1, 4 and 6; no joint encoders
None; arm falls when motors lose power
24 V DC, 5 A recommended; 18 V minimum
About 40 W typical
PAROL6 control board with STM32F446 and six TMC5160 drivers
USB; serial at 3 Mbaud; 100 Hz command cycle
2 isolated inputs; 2 isolated outputs; E-stop input
1 CAN bus for electric grippers; second bus is on the board but not populated
M8 4-pin gripper connector (24 V, CAN) at forearm; two pneumatic lines with 4 mm tube from base to forearm
6 base holes spaced for 30 × 30 mm aluminium profiles; clamps
Room temperature
claims.qualifier: Printed parts limit motor temperatures; see currents and temperatures section
claims.locator: PDF p.54, Technical data > Operating temperature

claims.qualifier: Manual points to additional constraints for joint 6 and exact limits
claims.locator: PDF p.54, Technical data > Joint ranges

claims.value: Joint-specific Python API and Commander maximum speeds; linear tool 200 mm/s API vs 60 mm/s Commander; angular tool 100°/s API vs 25°/s Commander
